svg.title: SleepEdit Administration and Shared Settings Flow

g.text: SleepEdit Administration and Shared Settings Flow
Validate host credential and unlock Admin state
Keep Admin locked and show an error
Import JSON with merge or replace mode
Clear user entries or reseed built-in list
Edit light, dark, and window tokens
Draft saved or safe failure; live theme unchanged
[Theme publish stops before LiteDB or live UI changes]
Theme is published; restart to apply it
Publish failure; shared file may already be updated
Save failure; shared policy may already be updated
Theme reads may fall back to the local published theme.
AI reads use LiteDB only when shared content is not configured.
